historical_location: Original plan WP0; SAP header; chronology audit sections 1-4
historical_specification: Public timestamped protocol archive was planned; SAP says prospective protocol lock.
actual_or_current_reporting: Internally specified study; current publication is retrospective. Original local times and hashes do not authenticate a complete pre-outcome history.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Retrospective reporting; exact earlier content history incomplete.
scientific_consequence: Keep local chronology and present publication date distinct; no backdating.

historical_location: Protocol sections 6 and 15; SAP section 2
historical_specification: Original eligibility required recovered biological replication; independent animal/library wording was used.
actual_or_current_reporting: Deposited arrays/libraries are observations. G205 proceeds conditionally on source replicate labels after the October public-evidence decision; animal linkage, pooling and batch remain unresolved.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: The October decision followed earlier results; no new animal map was recovered.
scientific_consequence: Do not equate accession/library identity with independently verified animals or replace unknowns with no pooling.

historical_location: Protocol section 11; original plan WP2-WP4
historical_specification: Sequential S1/S2/S3/J/E testing; zero retained candidates allowed.
actual_or_current_reporting: S1 evaluated 1,771 programs and admitted zero; S2/S3/J1-J4/E1/E2 have no eligible inputs, E3 was not run, and E4 is not computationally inferable.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Adjudication ledger is post-outcome; it retains the stopping rule.
scientific_consequence: No forced candidates; unevaluated downstream families are not negative tests.

historical_location: SAP section 2; deviations 29 August
historical_specification: G277 and G205 were described as held-out candidate validation sources.
actual_or_current_reporting: Completed source-wide studies are exploratory/contextual. No eligible candidate entered the sequential validation families.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: G277 source-wide analysis began after the recorded zero-S1 result; later additions are retrospective.
scientific_consequence: Separate independent data origins from outcome-protected validation.

historical_location: SAP section 3; deviations 18 August post-QC entry
historical_specification: Outcome-blind QC adjudication was intended.
actual_or_current_reporting: 26 arrays primary, excluding GSM418682 while retaining GSM418663; all27 sensitivity retained. Historical adjudication timing/information state is unverified.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Post-outcome provenance correction preserved; no reconstructed attestation proves blinding.
scientific_consequence: Report exact disposition and provenance limitation without changing the saved result.

historical_location: Protocol section 10; deviations 18 August mapping entry
historical_specification: Ensembl one-to-one orthology was planned.
actual_or_current_reporting: Frozen strict one-to-one NCBI gene-group-derived mapping is used. Current live mappings cannot replace the dated resource.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Internally recorded resource substitution; not independent proof of prospective freezing.
scientific_consequence: State the implemented source and preserve mapped-domain/version identities.

historical_location: Protocol section 9; deviations 18 August SynGO entry
historical_specification: SynGO was listed with primary program resources.
actual_or_current_reporting: QuickGO assignedBy=SynGO export is supplementary; it is not the official SynGO 1.3 bulk dataset and cannot admit candidates.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Early resource amendment; local chronology only.
scientific_consequence: Preserve the actual export identity and sensitivity-only interpretation.

historical_location: SAP section 4.3; October reference successor
historical_specification: Historical primary mRatBN7.2/RefSeq with Rsubread Subjunc.
actual_or_current_reporting: Main October results use Rnor6/Ensembl101, HISAT2 2.2.1 and featureCounts 2.0.6 for nine libraries. Older September objects remain a distinct branch.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: New-input plan formed with earlier results known; not an outcome-naive initial protocol.
scientific_consequence: Reference/annotation/count-domain changes are substantive and must not be described as simple filename aliases.

historical_location: Original SAP section 4.3; October matched comparison
historical_specification: STAR/Salmon mentioned as potential processing sensitivities.
actual_or_current_reporting: Completed matched STAR comparison reuses the nine libraries, Rnor6/Ensembl101 and the same featureCounts version/counting specification; no complete Salmon sensitivity is reported.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Retrospective processing sensitivity; primary HISAT2 result unchanged.
scientific_consequence: Compare branch-specific eligibility and continuous effects; do not count the branches as biological replication.

historical_location: SAP section 12; September reporting correction
historical_specification: Broad effect/95% CI reporting and historical edgeR-derived uncertainty columns.
actual_or_current_reporting: Unsupported historical edgeR gene intervals are omitted in current reporting; no replacement CI is invented. Voom/DESeq2 and activity uncertainty retain their own definitions.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Post-outcome reporting correction; coefficients, P/q and gates preserved.
scientific_consequence: G277 current gene views remove ql_se/ci_low/ci_high; signed_sqrt_F remains a ranking statistic.

historical_location: Original plan WP2/WP7; completed all30/predefined29 inputs
historical_specification: Chronic/acute comparisons and robustness were planned.
actual_or_current_reporting: All30 primary and predefined29 excluding GSM3681230/SRR8757507, each raw/adapter, remain separate. Same libraries under technical variants are not new cohorts.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Later source-wide sensitivity/reporting; no new S2 candidate family.
scientific_consequence: Keep denominators and shared observations explicit; do not select the most favorable discovery list.

historical_location: Original plan WP7; October full-label proposal
historical_specification: Design-preserving label references were broadly proposed.
actual_or_current_reporting: 268 sampled six-group families plus 180 day/sham exact families; original native results and candidate rules unchanged.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Full scope defined after original observations; not independent validation.
scientific_consequence: Keep reference spaces, native/empirical BH and missingness definitions separate.

historical_location: Original plan WP7; October preset-method proposal
historical_specification: edgeR versus voom/DESeq2 sensitivity.
actual_or_current_reporting: Three natural-course cell types, 45 libraries, six additional fits and 36 method/contrast families; original edgeR and S1 unchanged.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Retrospective execution of a previously planned method comparison.
scientific_consequence: Report rank agreement alongside changing thresholds, missingness and eligible domains.

historical_location: October separate-Linux and compatibility revision
historical_specification: Original Windows reference continuation; initial strict Windows/Linux bridge.
actual_or_current_reporting: Independent Linux observed/null outputs use frozen labels and Linux thresholds; 89 sampled and 34 complete companion families. Earlier strict numerical bridge failure remains a failure.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Compatibility rule revised with finite cross-platform differences already known; prior Windows results retained.
scientific_consequence: No platform pooling, no assertion of bitwise equality, and no additional empirical BH for these JGW descriptors.

historical_location: Original plan WP2/WP7
historical_specification: Leave-21d-out/leave-60d-out and leave-one-timepoint analyses.
actual_or_current_reporting: Current report provides exact design/estimability checks and component descriptions; it does not replace the interaction with a different contrast or claim a successful refit after deleting a defining timepoint.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Retrospective design review; no new fit.
scientific_consequence: An undefined original estimand is not a failed significance result.

historical_location: Original plan WP3/WP7
historical_specification: Low-RIN exclusion sensitivity.
actual_or_current_reporting: Published RNA-integrity records were crosswalked to libraries; missing vehicle values were not imputed, no new RIN cutoff or sample exclusion was introduced.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Current reporting disposition; complete input-dependent RIN exclusion sensitivity is not claimed.
scientific_consequence: Treat this original-plan item as unfulfilled, not as a passed sensitivity.

historical_location: Original plan WP3/WP7
historical_specification: Ratio/solvent/CEM-IEM/single-herb factorial analysis and G298414 ordinal-only sensitivity.
actual_or_current_reporting: Current core uses the fixed 36 JGW03 libraries; full preparation-factorial and G298414 sensitivity models are not reported as completed.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Selected core scope; this review does not establish that no historical exploratory file exists.
scientific_consequence: Preparation robustness/J4 remains unevaluated; do not infer product equivalence from canonical cultures.

historical_location: Original plan WP7
historical_specification: Leave-one-study/species-out and candidate selection frequencies/specification curve.
actual_or_current_reporting: Source-wise method and resource sensitivity outputs exist, but they do not establish a successful nonempty cross-study candidate-selection robustness analysis.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Known zero-S1 stopping state.
scientific_consequence: Do not count empty-family cross-study tests as completed negative validation or invent a top-k candidate set.

historical_location: Original validation objective; current holdout search boundary
historical_specification: Independent outcome-protected validation.
actual_or_current_reporting: No eligible broad-expression object linked to objective PSS physiology was identified in the documented targeted search. Stroke expression, clinical reports and same-data references do not substitute.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Targeted retrospective search; not an exhaustive systematic review.
scientific_consequence: Retain the study limitation; further calculations on the same matrices cannot fill this evidence gap.

historical_location: Original plan WP5; historical claims sections 1/6
historical_specification: Exact product identity, measured exposure and direct assay required before target claims.
actual_or_current_reporting: Product-specific literature evidence is contextual; no admitted E3 program with identity-matched exposure/direct assay establishes sequential E4.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Evidence curation after outcomes does not supply a new candidate admission.
scientific_consequence: Keep historical E1-E6 evidence classes separate from E1-E4 sequential gate labels.

historical_location: Protocol sections 3/12; original plan WP4/WP6
historical_specification: Separate muscle domain; spatial, virtual perturbation and structural work conditional on admissible upstream candidates.
actual_or_current_reporting: No qualifying candidate triggers spatial or structural work. The core manuscript makes no completed whole-chain muscle/causal/structural validation claim.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Original conditional scope retained.
scientific_consequence: Do not launch optional computations to manufacture mechanistic support.

historical_location: Original plan WP0; chronology audit section 7
historical_specification: Public protocol/code/ledger and clean reconstruction were planned.
actual_or_current_reporting: Versioned original code, selected inputs, data ledger and scoped checks are public. This release adds retrospective protocol records; full cold reconstruction and trusted preregistration remain unestablished.
chronology_and_outcome_visibility: Public release occurs after analyses. Historical recommendation to rerun every analysis does not override the current no-rerun instruction.
scientific_consequence: Reproduce from retained results where possible, identify untested execution routes, and preserve history.
